messages:
mike: rolling out v2.3.1 canary -> 10% eu-west (embed-service + router). releasing now, please watch SLOs. release notes: https://redwood-internal/releases/2.3.1 :shipit:

deploy-bot: started rollout v2.3.1 (commit: a1b2c3d) -> canary 10% eu-west. checks: preflight, smoke, health-probes. ETA traffic shift 30s.

emma: oncall here - watching p50/p95, 5xx, kvcache_miss. will post snapshots every 2m. :eyes:

sanjay: posted canary dashboard snapshot: https://grafana.redwood/d/abcd/embed-canary?orgId=1

laura: heads up - seeing 5xx spike on embed-service in eu-west starting ~10s after traffic shift. p95 jumped to ~750ms, 5xx rate ~1.6% (baseline 0.2%). logs show repeated tokenizer OOM in one pod.

mike: copy. log snippet?

laura: ```
2026-03-20T12:34:45Z ERROR tokenizer: failed to allocate buffer
java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: failed to allocate 32768 bytes
 at com.redwood.tokenize.Tokenizer.process(Tokenizer.java:218)
 at embed-service.v2.RequestHandler.handle(RequestHandler.java:88)
```

alex: that stack points at the new quantize path we enabled in 2.3.1 (AUTO_QUANTIZE=true). could be mem regression under bursty inputs.

sanjay: correlating kvcache_eviction and heap. kvcache_miss rate also increased in same window. looks like eviction + quantize memory spike.

ops-bot: alert: embed-service-eu-west-5xx-rate fired (threshold 0.5%). incident: https://pagerduty.redwood/incidents/PD12345

emma: current canary is 10%, error rate 1.6% > SLO (0.5%). recommend pause and rollback/pin.

mike: hold on traffic shift. prefer pin to previous stable (2.3.0) for canary while we validate fix. timeline: pin now, run smoke, then either resume or rollback full if persists.

laura: prepared quick revert of AUTO_QUANTIZE flag in helm chart (branch: fix/quantize-guard). patch: a1b2c3d -> reverting flag.

mike: how fast to flip pin? command?

sanjay: I can flip routing. set to pin 2.3.0 for embed-service canary only: `rbacctl route update embed-service --canary-version 2.3.0 --region eu-west`

alex: also toggle `AUTO_QUANTIZE=false` on canary pods to confirm. small k8s job: `kubectl -n embed set env deploy/embed-service AUTO_QUANTIZE=false --overwrite`

emma: go ahead with pin + env toggle. I'll watch error and p95. run load smoke afterwards: `k6 run smoke/embed-canary.js` and watch `errors_total` & `kvcache_miss` metrics.

deploy-bot: rollout paused by mike (reason: alert - embed-service 5xx spike). current canary remains at 10% pinned to 2.3.0 after route update.

ops-bot: pagerduty incident updated: assigned to @laura and @emma.

laura: pinned canary to 2.3.0 and applied env toggle on the three affected pods. patch log: https://github.com/redwood/embed-service/commit/d4e5f6.

sanjay: smoke load started (k6) against pinned canary, 2m run.

emma: early readout: errors back to baseline ~0.18%, p95 down to 120ms. kvcache_miss normalized.

mike: nice. leaving rollout paused for now. we'll keep canary pinned while we merge laura's revert and run full integration tests. plan to resume traffic shift after CI and an hour of stable metrics.

alex: filing a short postmortem checklist: root cause = quantize memory regression + eviction interaction. follow-ups: add memory safety guard in quantize path, add kvcache eviction telemetry, add canary auto-pause threshold at 0.5% 5xx.

emma: adding incident channel `#inc-embed-2212345678` and scheduling 15m blameless review at 13:00 UTC.

mike: thanks everyone. note for release notes: marking v2.3.1 as paused in eu-west canary; pushing a note to release page. https://redwood-internal/releases/2.3.1/notes - will update. :thumbsup:

laura: creating PR for revert and will request fast-tracking.

emma: monitoring continues. will close pagerduty if stable for 30m.

mike: closing thread update: canary pinned + rollout paused. continuing with revert PR -> CI -> resume window. will follow up in the incident channel.
